title: Restaurant kitchen and floor rota with time off

unsupported.quote: every evening we need at least one personal licence holder on the floor for the bar
unsupported.reason: The catalog has no 'at least one of the assigned resources has an attribute' rule: requires_attribute applies to every assignment, so it would demand that everyone on the evening floor holds a personal licence.

notes: Time off comes from a CSV window source (time_off.csv); Nina's window ends exactly when the Friday floor lunch ends (half-open intervals, no overlap). The 11-hour rest rule rules out lunch-and-dinner doubles and blocks Friday and Saturday closers from the next lunch, but it ignores overlapping shifts (ADR-0005), so the request also states that nobody works two shifts at once (only Sam could). The reference solution also honours the licence request (ADR-0007 §4): every dinner floor shift has a personal licence holder. The reference score -3 is optimal: Sophie can only get the three lunches outside her time off (-6), and 15 weekend slots over 12 people give a spread of at least 1 (+3). Disruption: Ben is ill on Friday 4 December; a feasible re-plan exists (hard 0) that also honours the licence request.
